excerpt: vulkan: further optimize coopmat2 GDN (#32860) vulkan: further optimize coopmat2 GDN Refactor split+store callbacks so hi and lo portions are all stored together. This should help allow the stores to be vectorized. Interleave the state store callbacks with the gram_pmat work. The compiler doesn't seem to let these things overlap without manual effort like this. I suspect this is because the compiler doesn't have smart enough alias analyssis to know what can/can't conflict. Similarly, split the invert function into separate calculation/store calls, so the inverse work can interleave better with the MMAs.
